$comment: Layer 05/06 delta L0506-D001 (TOOL-041): the prepared runtime numeric domain. Scenarios live in conformance/agent/prepared-runtime/, discriminated by a top-level `prepared_runtime` key. For each case a runner makes ONE tool call through the REAL Layer 06 pipeline (resolve, prepare_arguments, validation, the tools/pre-execute hook, execute) with a pre-execute listener that records the prepared value at each `observe` JSON pointer, and (custom tools) an execute that records the same. It performs no preparation, validation or numeric conversion itself. VALUE TOKENS: a runtime number is rendered as "+Infinity", "-Infinity", "NaN", "-0", or ECMAScript Number::toString of the finite value (an integral value decoded as a binding integer renders the same way, e.g. "9007199254740992"); a non-number renders as its JSON text.

token.$comment: a value token (see the top-level comment)

tool.$comment: edit: the REAL built-in edit tool over a fresh root holding f.txt = "a\n" (its own prepare_arguments, prepareEditArguments). custom: a tool named `probe` whose parameters are `schema` and whose prepare_arguments returns the arguments with `prepare_set` applied (Pi's public AgentTool.prepareArguments shim); its execute records the observed values and succeeds

schema.$comment: custom only. number: {type: object, properties: {limit: {type: number}}, required: [limit]}; integer: the same with {type: integer}; open: {type: object, properties: {}}

prepare_set.$comment: custom only: keys the prepare_arguments callback sets, each to the runtime number its token denotes

arguments.$comment: the raw ToolCall arguments (JSON); the runner also requires them unchanged after the call

outcome.$comment: argument_validation_failure: Layer 06's certified immediate argument-validation error (its text is Layer 06's own); neither the hook nor execute runs

observed.$comment: prepared only: the token at each observed pointer, as the pre-execute hook sees it and (custom) as execute receives it

result_text.$comment: edit only: the tool's success text
